semantics.stable_rule: Unchanged stable_windows:12 completed transitions; both physics samples >=2 object-contact fingertips >0.1N; object root z >=median completed25-48+0.02m; palm-relative root drift<=0.01m and relative quaternion angle<=0.2rad.
semantics.boundaries: Eligibility requires12 transitions wholly in the same declared authority/label phase AND recorded segment. Completed endpoints before48 are separate because the settled-height reference is not yet available. Student, masked expert queue and legal expert labels never share an eligible window.
semantics.reference: Exact full-trajectory median after-object-root z at indices24:48. If takeover occurs before48, this reference includes expert frames; such student-trigger qualification is not claimed.
semantics.approach: First same-phase/segment stable window on native first goal to first subsequent near_goal on that goal. This includes observed rotation/approach; it is not an isolated rotation-only stage. Native near_goal/alignment/subgoal/completion are recorded diagnostics, never new success criteria.
semantics.prospective_screens: Read-only comparisons at eligible endpoints on first goal strictly before its first near_goal flag. contact_height12 retains the exact existing12tick two-finger/two-substep>0.1N and +0.02m settled-height requirements, omitting relative translation/rotation conditions. contact_native_lift12 instead requires the recorded native lifted flag for all12ticks with the same contacts. Neither screen is deployed or a recommendation to change thresholds; success-only student prefixes cannot estimate failed-state false positives.
semantics.goal: Post-transition object is compared with pre-transition active goal, so a goal reset cannot substitute the next target. Raw root-origin quaternion angles ignore shape symmetry.
semantics.denominator: Successful training trajectories only: original30 and54 admitted successful suffixes, not new independent families or all collection opportunities. Student prefixes stop at their actual expert intervention and are censored at varying clocks; 5/54 or6/54 is not a full-rollout qualification rate. Per-tick counts and per-trajectory counts are distinct. Failure-condition counts overlap.
semantics.interpretation: False stable-window flag is not evidence of dropping, unintended slip or unrecoverability. Recorded expert success is not autonomous student success. Expert coverage alone cannot establish current student trigger qualification rate or justify a threshold change.
semantics.provenance: Actual required numeric HDF5 tensors are reread and hashed. Entire raw RGB-D/HDF5 bytes are not rehashed; source_manifest_sha256 records existing manifest provenance.
